CSV format and supported fields

Required: name. Optional: category, city, capacity, minGuests, priceLow, priceHigh, pricing, tags, sourceUrl, notes, availableDates, moods. Separate tags with |. Assign one primary mood. Mood values: cozy, outdoor, social, coastal, classic, food, casual, celebrate, private. Categories: venue, catering, photography, other. Pricing: flat, person, hour.

About Supperlune

An early project, built with Codex.

This tool helps you turn venue research into a source-linked shortlist for small gatherings in San Diego. Supperlune is the working name for this project; trademark clearance is pending.

Matching and text extraction use local rules. You review the source details and confirm the supplier’s quote and availability. No automated outreach or booking is performed.

Your listings stay in this browser. Export a backup to keep them portable. The starter venues and caterer come from official pages checked October 20, 2026. Fictional demo data is separate.
